scope: AIC Markdown functionality implemented by standard-notes-aic and aic-notes

status.currentFacts: Entrypoints and verification paths describe the current working trees. The aic-notes/vendor copies are distribution artifacts and are not independent feature owners.
status.approvedDirection: Maintain one stable registry of user-visible features, shared runtime capabilities, and host adapters.
status.reviewPending: Reviewers must confirm feature boundaries and close the declared coverage gaps before treating this registry as exhaustive.

hosts.shared-core: Canonical reusable editor behavior owned by standard-notes-aic/src/core
hosts.pwa: Device-local portable file and folder Notes app

coveragePolicy: Every canonical src .ts/.js/.css file and every aic-notes src or vendor/markdown .js/.css adapter file must appear in at least one feature sourceFiles array. Distributed aic-notes/vendor/aic-editor-core copies are excluded because their canonical owners are standard-notes-aic/src/core.

features.purpose: Open local .md workspaces without a password in the PWA, persist explicitly unencrypted device snapshots through the existing controller/storage owner, and optionally create an interoperable encrypted copy without deleting the plaintext source. Filter new imports and navigation to Markdown, count only selected notes toward the import quota, and retain hierarchy through file paths with separately bounded scanning/export. Use four-lane metadata/byte reads with all-size preflight, cooperative task yields and 30-second per-I/O deadlines. Expose opening progress and cancellation without partial workspace mutations, render Markdown navigation incrementally with filename filtering while retaining the active editor/draft, and reuse canonical validation for unchanged file data while checking metadata. Preserve existing bundle bytes and explicit folder records, explicit exports and user-owned synchronization; retain the browser page-library and VS Code encrypted-file boundaries. On mobile, show the searchable Notes browser or the editor with contextual document/workspace menus. Create uniquely named editable drafts immediately; validated renames preserve file IDs. Open creates a separate workspace and Add merges. Preserve the mounted editor for same-document navigation, filtering and layout changes; local autosave shares the existing save/CAS owner, retains failed drafts and exposes Retry with accurate device-local status. Show a file explorer and one Current, Shared folder/site, or Global project/profile note at a time, preserving mounted scope editors and the single save owner. VS Code encrypted-file saves refuse deleted existing files and retain recoverable encrypted changes.

Use browser-owned local inference to fix grammar or improve selected prose, protecting code, links, properties and secret fences. Apply a reviewed suggestion as one undoable edit only while the original document and selection remain current.

Publish bilingual terms, the existing privacy policy, release history, installation instructions and a document-authoring How to at aic.dzyha.com. Serve the offline documents at clean URLs and repair redirected HTML in previous shell caches without changing note storage or forcing app-update activation.

Verify exact release packages before browser or VS Code marketplace submission, and propose reviewed updates of the canonical editor core and portable runtime with real commit provenance. Store and repository access must be configured before activation.
Compose CodeMirror, document switching, host save callbacks, access state, theme refresh, and teardown.
Provide Markdown parsing, nested fenced-language support, syntax highlighting, and reveal decorations.

Render headings, smaller italic and quote text, softly shaded quote blocks with a side rule, short centered horizontal rules, lists, links, code fences, and other structured Markdown previews with readable spacing without replacing source truth.

Provide one always-compact Standard Notes/browser toolbar with direct strike, link, bullet, ordered and task-list actions while keyboard, Markdown and slash commands own the omitted formatting operations; also preserve list continuation, indentation and one-operation undo boundaries.
Render and toggle Markdown task checkboxes with keyboard, read-only, stale-control, and ARIA safeguards.
Open or copy safe external links and route verified local links through the owning host.
Render language-aware fenced-code cards with copy/edit/cut controls while preserving unsupported source. Cut copies the complete Markdown block before removing it.
Render tables, copy or cut the complete Markdown block, insert and reorder rows or columns, and edit one cell through a bounded popover.

Parse and render details accordions with readable wrapping titles, consistent source actions, and inset nested previews inside a continuous parent boundary while retaining whole-block cut, links, tasks, comments, and open state.

Parse and render independently typed pipe values, including explicit one-time states, inside the single bounded aic document while preserving retired YAML Properties as raw Markdown without conversion.

Parse and render bounded AIC credential blocks with masking, independently scoped field/section/block copy, whole-block cut, add, delete, filtering, diagnostics, responsive whole-item wrapping, and exact-source reordering. Labels and typed values use natural width and wrap as complete items before text breaks; passwords use compact lock-only copy targets, short card/TOTP values stay intact, and creation controls continue the final value. Larger section headings, neutral group backgrounds and subtle alternating gray row surfaces distinguish the hierarchy. Icon-only password, section and block copy targets show temporary success checkmarks or failure crosses while keeping stable accessible action names and live feedback. Leaving block source edit or whole-note source mode stably sorts labelled rows in natural case-insensitive order within each section, with unlabelled rows last; exact authored rows, value order and section order are preserved. Section copy preserves type and masking markers. Cut removes source only after clipboard success.

Handle card parts, password generation for every empty editable secret part regardless of label or width, with responsive options and read-only guards, TOTP derivation, QR parsing, and recovery-code state under explicit security limits.
Convert recognized Authenticator JSON into bounded security blocks as an explicit undoable draft action with host save acknowledgement.
Edit Mermaid as source with a live preview, copy or cut the complete fence, preview-only zoom, cancellation, and stale-result isolation.
Offer grouped slash templates and placeholder navigation for pages, sections, assurance, references, data, diagrams, and primitive content.
Track dirty drafts, isolate note identity, centralize explicit/focus/action saves, process exact acknowledgements, retain failures, and retire stale async work.
Recognize AIC agentic note markers and shared note-contract metadata without activating external workflows itself.

Define the shared component IDs, BEM class application, button factory, geometry tokens, and additive migration surface used by host adapters. Indicate unsaved changes on the save button with a soft pulse and static reduced-motion accent, preserving the document background and text colors.

Build one short inert local editor guide, enabled by the shared editor by default and explicitly suppressed when the browser panel owns its trigger, while each host owns popover placement, focus, Escape handling, and disposal.
Translate Standard Notes component contexts into snapshots and guarded save targets with lock, identity, timeout, and disposal checks.
Run the editor as a development demo with plaintext localStorage persistence; it is not a credential-safe production host.
Encrypt the local browser library, keep unlock material in trusted session storage, validate bounded records, serialize writes, and lock all panels.

Create on first edit, save, export, copy, and delete exact-URL page notes while retaining failed local drafts. Pin a saved note while browsing and add deduplicated active-page related links atomically when typing. Focused Current/Shared/Global tabs expose one scope at a time through an acknowledged save barrier.

Store one exact-origin shared AIC document separately from page Markdown, render a masked preview, and expose an explicit short-lived editor through the shared scope draft owner. Focused Current/Shared/Global tabs expose one scope at a time through an acknowledged save barrier.

Keep one explicit profile-local Global AIC record in encrypted library v3, visible across all origins and without a web page. Reuse the shared masked renderer and revisioned draft owner; losslessly migrate v1/v2 and report backup singleton conflicts without overwriting either source. Focused Current/Shared/Global tabs expose one scope at a time through an acknowledged save barrier.
Project saved metadata-only page ancestors from the exact origin and strict URL path into a compact root-to-current navigation chain.

Record bounded recent pages, group saved notes by domain/path, filter safe display metadata, show compact labels without query or fragment data, and open only known stored destinations without changing their exact URLs.

Capture the explicitly selected current page content or selection, sanitize it into Markdown, resolve safe links, and append page or file content after permission and navigation-race checks; shared outline icons distinguish page capture, file import and file export in the browser header; native paste remains editor-owned.
Export and import encrypted browser-library backups with validated merge, identity collision handling, quotas, and explicit passphrase flow.

Own side-panel context, private-window consent, trusted message boundaries, visibility teardown, plaintext cleanup, theme refresh, and stale async cancellation. Keep only navigation, More options, and Lock in the header; expose named context-appropriate transfer, pinning and help actions inside the existing bounded menu.
Register commands, views, editors, nesting defaults, lifecycle ownership, and host capability boundaries.
Map files, folders, and workspace roots to canonical .note.md sidecars and memory-only placeholders without note-of-note recursion.

Host Markdown in a custom editor with UTF-16 change synchronization, stale-generation reset, undo/redo delegation, source/link routing, clipboard, and edit leases. Show Current, nearest Shared folder note, and Global project note through the shared scope tabs; preserve the original Current anchor and each native document owner.

Follow or pin the active source's sidecar, show the nearest existing parent for an active note, preserve drafts, and provide explicit source/target navigation. Scope tabs open only existing related notes and preserve the original source anchor across save-gated navigation.

Resolve linked-note relationships and source navigation, keep the compact header free of duplicated file dates, and optionally configure ordinary Explorer nesting without an extension-specific tree. Reject saves of deleted existing Markdown files and linked notes while retaining their drafts; genuine untitled files and new note placeholders can still be created.
Insert a deduplicated source-selection reference into the live linked-note draft and reopen verified local source ranges.
Confirm and move one sidecar or a selected folder's indexed sidecars to Trash, with an explicit permanent fallback only when necessary.
Expose the shared slash catalog in native and untitled Markdown while disabling it in code and read-only contexts.
Expose bundled agent instructions and enable a trusted workspace handoff without executing AIC or changing global configuration.
Remove retired authentication/sync state exactly once and verify shared-core integrity, packaging contents, checksums, licenses, and release boundaries.

Bundle one agent-neutral Markdown instruction guide in every extension without requiring a separate AIC executable or config folder. Reference the current DDK writing method: establish the reader and next action, answer necessary questions by meaning, and stop at sufficient detail while preserving AIC Markdown and typed blocks.

coverageGaps: The registry is source- and test-derived, not runtime instrumentation; dynamically generated control variants may still need finer component entries.

Authenticated Standard Notes desktop/mobile behavior, live VS Code remote or virtual workspaces, Chromium store packaging, and cross-platform assistive-technology behavior are not exhaustively verified by the listed automated tests.
Build, release, provenance, license, and deployment mechanics are represented as adapter/release features but are not decomposed into every script flag or CI job.
Vendor copies under aic-notes/vendor are intentionally references to the canonical shared owner and are not independently enumerated.
